methodology: External human-labelled QASPER; full text paragraphs preloaded as confirmed records in an isolated in-memory database. Gold annotations never sent to retrieval. Not LLM extraction, generation, business accuracy or official QASPER answer F1. K counts memory paragraphs; latency is debug retrieval only, includes initial index construction, excludes network.

provenance.adaptation: Deterministic paper-disjoint 20/80 question split; all full-text paragraphs retained. Text-only evidence matches; no translation, model-generated labels, question-specific extraction or ranking tuning.
provenance.citation: Dasigi et al. (2021), A Dataset of Information-Seeking Questions and Answers Anchored in Research Papers.
